CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

2. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 9
   C. 32
   D. 8

3. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 1

4. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 49

5. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/2

7. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

8. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

9. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

10. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 77
   C. 22
   D. 18

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 105
   B. 44
   C. 30
   D. 22

13. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

14. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

15. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 15.7

16. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
